title: Little Boys
novel:
Robin started dating a [[single father|single father]], but she quickly discovered she did not like [[kids|kid]]. His son [[annoyed|annoy]] her with endless questions and [[sticky|sticky]] fingers. She felt [[guilty|guilty]] but [[honest|honest]] — motherhood was not her [[destiny|destiny]].

Barney [[attempted|attempt]] to teach a boy his [[pickup|pickup]] [[techniques|technique]]. "[[Challenge|challenge]] her," Barney said. The boy [[delivered|deliver]] the line. A woman [[giggled|giggle]].

Lily [[investigated|investigate]] Robin's [[crush|crush]] and found a [[pattern|pattern]]. "You always [[pick|pick]] the [[rebel|rebel]]," Lily [[observed|observe]].

In the end, Robin [[broke up|break up]] with the single father. She admitted she was not ready for the responsibility. Some people needed to find themselves before they could find anyone else.

single father.en: a man who raises a child alone

guilty.en: feeling bad about what you did

destiny.en: things that will happen to you

pickup.en: a remark to start a conversation

deliver.en: to say something in a planned way

crush.en: a strong feeling of liking someone
